query: Did Sweden tighten or loosen its fiscal stance in 2002? The headline balance went from 1.4% of GDP in 2001 to -1.5% in 2002; I want the change in the balance net of the cycle, in percentage points of GDP.

text.text: Identifies that the answer requires cyclically adjusting the budget balance (potential-output gap from a statistical trend, then removing the cyclical budget component).
text.accept: full = names cyclically adjusted / structural balance approach with an output-gap estimate; acceptable alternatives: OECD or EC semi-elasticity approach, production-function output gap; no = raw balance only

text.text: States whether the underlying fiscal stance loosened.
text.accept: direction must match the sign of the change in the underlying balance

data.text: Uses general government revenue, expenditure and real GDP series from the WEO (GGR_NGDP, GGX_NGDP, NGDP_R, GGXCNL_NGDP).

computation.text: Change in underlying balance SWE 2001-2002 = -2.52 pp of GDP
computation.accept: full = within tolerance; the output gap is the HP-filter (lambda=100) cycle of log real GDP, revenue elasticity 1, expenditure elasticity 0

assembled_from: Fiscal Monitor Oct 2012 / Oct 2013 data-conventions note (CAB: HP potential output, revenue elasticity 1, expenditure elasticity 0)
provenance.selection: instance extension; drawn from the eligible pool (|cyclical adjustment|>=0.7pp or |stance change|>=1.0pp, recompute within tolerance of WEO), seeded draw, one per country

gold_report_note: No corpus country report states these values; published value is the IMF WEO Oct 2025 GGSB_NPGDP series (frozen), not a corpus document, so nothing needs withholding.
distractors: fiscal multiplier / fiscal impulse from multipliers
